area: Funnel, Journeys, Customer 360, Behavior, Match Quality
observation: These pages calculate from a recent window (latest 500 lead profiles or 5,000 events), not the whole workspace. Funnel reports 500 leads while 10,000+ exist.
recommendation: Move these totals to database aggregates, as was done for Lead Grading and now Follow-ups. This touches 18 call sites, so it was not changed in this run.

observation: http://localhost:5173 on this PC opens a different project ("Apex CRM"): another Vite server owns the IPv6 localhost:5173 listener.
recommendation: Open AceMarketing at http://127.0.0.1:5173, or stop the other dev server.

observation: With AUTH_REQUIRED unset, the API serves reads without a token and accepts any password for the owner account. This is by design for local development.
recommendation: Set AUTH_REQUIRED=true (or run in production mode) before the stack is reachable by anyone else.

observation: A customer who messages on WhatsApp gets a second lead profile keyed by phone number (source "WhatsApp") instead of being merged into their existing profile with the same phone hash.
recommendation: Stitch WhatsApp senders to an existing profile by phone hash before creating a new one.

observation: 3 of 208 backend foundation tests fail on this PC, with or without today's changes: control idempotency (2) and secure object lifecycle (1). The in-memory test database does not honour the ON CONFLICT unique key that real PostgreSQL enforces.
recommendation: Run these three against PostgreSQL, or pin the pg-mem version they last passed with.

observation: Records created by earlier feed versions remain: 4,711 A-grade leads, names ending in "(test)", and about 11,000 open follow-ups. The Python feed now completes the most overdue follow-ups each cycle.
recommendation: Reset the local test database if a clean baseline is wanted.

observation: 7 routes stay blocked: recommendation reviewer, multimodal extraction, embeddings, reranking, call transcription, live voice and creative image (Anthropic, Google, Voyage). Knowledge sources therefore stay at "pending_embedding" and activation proposals cannot be reviewed. The analyst sends about 350 KB of evidence per question, which makes each answer take about a minute.
recommendation: Add those provider keys, or route more text tasks to the NVIDIA endpoint; trim the analyst evidence snapshot to speed answers up.

observation: google-meridian 2.1.0 requires numpy below 2.4; the working ML stack runs numpy 2.5.3. Installing it would downgrade the libraries every other pipeline depends on, so it was left out.
recommendation: Run the marketing-mix profile as a separate ML service (ML_MMM_SERVICE_URL) with its own environment.

observation: Anomaly detection, segmentation, Chronos forecasting and incrementality run and persist results, but are not counted as "active routes": their evaluations report no metrics to qualify against, or they register no deployable artifact.
recommendation: Decide what evidence should qualify these tasks, then add it to their results.

area: Pages with no local data source
observation: Boards (no card-creation API), ChatGPT Ads, signal deliveries on AdSync/Delivery, connector data on Integrations. Loopback webhook destinations are deliberately blocked by the egress policy, so local delivery cannot be simulated honestly.
recommendation: Connect real test destinations; these pages then fill from real deliveries.

observation: Still a single 23 MB JSON document. Reads are now cheap; each write still rewrites the whole document (p95 request time about 1 s).
recommendation: Move the large event histories (WhatsApp, call, recent events, personalization) into their own tables.

observation: Ad-platform delivery, CRM writeback, outbound WhatsApp and calls, calendar sync, report e-mail, Stripe billing and file storage are marked Blocked per feature.
recommendation: Connect provider test accounts, then re-run npm run live:verify:features.
